chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman, from his father, from Abu Basir, who said:

One day the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was sitting when the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) arrived. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: 'In you there is a resemblance to Isa son of Mary, and had it not been that groups from my community would say about you what the Christians say about Isa son of Mary, I would have said about you something such that whenever you pass among any people they would take the dust from beneath your feet, seeking blessings thereby.'

He (the narrator) said: The two Bedouin Arabs and al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah and a number from the Quraysh with them became angry and said: 'He was not satisfied until he took Isa son of Mary as an example for the son of his uncle.'

So Allah revealed to His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), saying: 'And when the son of Mary was cited as an example, behold, your people raised a clamour at it. And they said: Are our gods better or is he? They do not cite it to you but by way of disputation; nay, they are a contentious people. He was but a servant whom We favoured and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. And had We willed, We would have made from you — meaning from Banu Hashim — angels in the earth to succeed.' [43:57-60]

He (the narrator) said: Al-Harith ibn Amr al-Fihri became angry and said: 'O Allah! If this is the truth from You that Banu Hashim will be inheriting like Heraclius after Heraclius, then rain stones upon us from the sky or bring upon us a painful punishment.'

So Allah revealed in response to the words of al-Harith, and this verse descended: 'But Allah would not chastise them while you were among them, nor will Allah chastise them while they seek forgiveness.' [8:33]

Then he (the Prophet) said to him: 'O Ibn Amr, either you repent or you leave.' He said: 'O Muhammad! Rather, give the rest of Quraysh something from what is in your hands, for Banu Hashim has taken away the prestige of the Arabs and the non-Arabs.' The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: 'That is not up to me; that is up to Allah, Blessed and Exalted.' He said: 'O Muhammad! My heart does not submit to repentance, but I shall leave you.' So he called for his mount and rode away. When he reached the outskirts of Medina, a stone fell upon him and crushed his skull.

Then revelation came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), saying: 'One who demanded demanded a chastisement that must fall — upon the disbelievers in the wilayah of Ali — which none can repel from Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways.' [70:1-3 — as revealed]

He (the narrator) said: I said, 'May I be sacrificed for you, we do not read it thus.' He said: 'By Allah! Jibraeel descended with it thus to Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and by Allah! It is thus recorded in the parchment (mushaf) of Fatimah (peace be upon her).'

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) then said to those around him from the hypocrites: 'Go to your companion, for he has received what he was seeking.' Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'And they sought judgment and every insolent oppressor was frustrated.' [14:15]

key_terms.جَنْدَلَةٌ: A large stone — here referring to the divine punishment that struck al-Harith ibn Amr al-Fihri
key_terms.مَلَإٌ: A gathering of prominent people, assembly
key_terms.مُصْحَفُ فَاطِمَةَ: The Mushaf (parchment/codex) of Fatimah — a compilation recorded by Fatimah al-Zahra (AS) after the death of the Prophet, regarded in Shia tradition as containing revealed material not in the standard Quran
key_terms.هِرَقْلٌ: Heraclius — the Byzantine Emperor, used here mockingly by al-Harith to suggest the Banu Hashim were claiming dynastic hereditary power
key_terms.وَلَايَةُ عَلِيٍّ: The authority/guardianship of Ali — the Shia doctrine that Ali ibn Abi Talib was the divinely appointed successor to the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about the similarity between Imam Ali and Jesus ibn Maryam?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates how the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) praised the spiritual station of Imam Ali (AS) by drawing a comparison to Jesus ibn Maryam (AS), warning that an even greater statement could be made but for fear of exaggeration by some followers. The narrative demonstrates a series of Quranic revelations responding to the objections of hypocrites and opponents of the Ahl al-Bayt, culminating in the divine punishment of al-Harith ibn Amr al-Fihri who challenged Allah with mockery. Most significantly, the Imam reveals a variant reading of Surah al-Ma'arij (70:1-2) that explicitly names the wilayah (authority) of Ali as the reason for the threatened punishment, stating this was the true revelation brought by Jibraeel and preserved in the Mushaf of Fatimah (AS).
